headings: A fruity, woody fragrance with notes of black mango, guava, and saffron, created by Jo Malone CBE.

jsonld_raw.name: SERA A TAORMINA MANGO & OUD PARFUM 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
SERA A TAORMINA MANGO & OUD PARFUM 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ). The Art of Becoming, a collection inspired by the journey to your most authentic self. The moment you decide to follow your instincts and leave the familiar behind. The air is warm, anything seems possible, and every experience awakens a new version of you. Black mango and guava release a vibrant intensity, illuminated by the spicy brightness of saffron. Patchouli and benzoin add a warm, sophisticated depth, leaving a free and unexpected trail.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Woody fruity | Bold, exotic, and magnetic
